LanguageData.Make_Raven_Mech_Aegis.description: Initiate the cultivation pod's extreme remolding protocol. By inserting mechanical remains and a Shattered Sun Core, deep body modification begins.\n\nOver three long gestation cycles, countless pipelines will connect to her core, continuously injecting enhancement mediums and performing high-frequency calibrations. Once the 'Core Reforging', 'Sensory Overwrite', and 'Constant Standby' stages are complete, her once-sacred body will be completely transformed into an ultimate weapon, absolutely loyal to your directives.
